ideas.pitch: Real-time coastal erosion and marine hazard forecasting platform for local La Jolla beaches using statistical regression models and visual satellite alerts.
ideas.title: LaJollaWavePredictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a location-specific environmental issue highly relevant to the judges and local community in La Jolla, leveraging the forecasting pattern seen in winning submissions.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous peer-to-peer surf gear rental marketplace featuring instant USDC escrow payments and reputation-based AI agent verification.
ideas.title: SurfSideEscrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the successful autonomous agent and USDC escrow marketplace pattern to a hyper-local recreational use case popular in coastal California.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered municipal logistics and route-matching app that groups local organic waste generators with bio-refinery collection drivers to minimize city emissions.
ideas.title: BioFuelSanDiego
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates clear, measurable environmental impact and practical social good, mirroring the formula that won the Vanderbilt Global Good Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: No-code algorithmic trading strategy builder tailored for decentralized prediction markets, featuring backtesting and automated execution.
ideas.title: TideTradeAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds on proven financial tech hackathon success by offering a robust no-code execution platform that appeals to technical judges.

ideas.pitch: AI-driven wellness and dining hall assistant that optimizes student meal plans based on real-time campus cafeteria menus and nutritional constraints.
ideas.title: CampusNutriSync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly solves a daily pain point felt by students and organizers in the room during a multi-day in-person hackathon.
